channel.title: Firstwater Blog
channel.description: Writing on sound, sessions, and what people put down in them. From Daniel, also known as Firstwater.

item.title: Should I bring someone?
item.description: A Denver facilitator on whether to come to a sound session alone or with someone: what each one changes, what the seventy-five minutes does either way, and the one night where it matters.

item.title: What people ask me about crying
item.description: A Denver facilitator on crying during a sound bath: how often it happens, what the space does when it does, and why people apologize for it afterward.

item.title: A nap is a legitimate outcome
item.description: People fall asleep in sound baths all the time and ask afterward whether they missed it. A Denver facilitator on what the hour is actually for, and why sleep is one of the outcomes it was built to allow.

item.title: I'm not a skeptic, and I'm not a believer
item.description: A Denver music producer on whether sound healing works: which claims are false, what the real science says, and why the hour can still be worth having.

item.title: Isolated together
item.description: A group sound bath and the same sound alone at home are different practices. A Denver facilitator on what most sound baths miss about the group, and what changes when people practice side by side.
